plan: Genesis 36:1-19; 1 Chronicles 1:35-37; Genesis 36:20-30; 1 Chronicles 1:38-42; Genesis 36:31-43; 1 Chronicles 1:43-54; 1 Chronicles 2:1-2

readings.title: Severing the Camp
readings.subtitle: Esau Withdraws to Mount Seir
readings.text: [Genesis 36:1] And this is the genealogy of Ěsav, who is Eḏom. [2] Ěsav took <dn>את</dn> his wives from the daughters of Kena‛an: <dn>את</dn> Aḏah the daughter of Ělon the Ḥittite, and <dn>את</dn> Oholiḇamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Tsiḇ‛on the Ḥivvite; [3] and <dn>את</dn> Basemath, Yishma‛ĕl’s daughter, sister of Neḇayoth. [4] And Aḏah bore <dn>את</dn> Eliphaz to Ěsav, and Basemath bore <dn>את</dn> Re‛u’ĕl. [5] And Oholiḇamah bore <dn>את</dn> Ye‛ush, and <dn>את</dn> Ya‛lam, and <dn>את</dn> Qoraḥ. These were the sons of Ěsav who were born to him in the land of Kena‛an. [6] And Ěsav took <dn>את</dn> his wives, and <dn>את</dn> his sons, and <dn>את</dn> his daughters, and <dn>את</dn> all the beings of his household, and <dn>את</dn> his herds and <dn>את</dn> all his beasts, and <dn>את</dn> all his possessions which he had gained in the land of Kena‛an, and went to a land away from the presence of his brother Ya‛aqoḇ. [7] For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojournings could not support <dn>את</dn> them because of their herds. [8] So Ěsav dwelt in Mount Sĕ‛ir. Ěsav is Eḏom.

readings.title: Proliferation of Esau’s Line
readings.subtitle: The Emergence of the Edomite Estate
readings.text: [Genesis 36:9] And this is the genealogy of Ěsav the father of the Eḏomites in Mount Sĕ‛ir. [10] These were the names of Ěsav’s sons: Eliphaz son of Aḏah, wife of Ěsav, and Re‛u’ĕl son of Basemath, wife of Ěsav. [11] And the sons of Eliphaz were Tĕman, Omar, Tsepho, and Gatam, and Qenaz. [12] And Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Ěsav’s son, and she bore <dn>את</dn> Amalĕq to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Aḏah, Ěsav’s wife. [13] These were the sons of Re‛u’ĕl: Naḥath and Zeraḥ, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Ěsav’s wife. [14] These were the sons of Oholiḇamah, Ěsav’s wife, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Tsiḇ‛on. And she bore to Ěsav: <dn>את</dn> Ye‛ush, and <dn>את</dn> Ya‛lam, and <dn>את</dn> Qoraḥ. [15] These were the chiefs of the sons of Ěsav. The sons of Eliphaz, the first-born son of Ěsav, were Chief Tĕman, Chief Omar, Chief Tsepho, Chief Qenaz, [16] Chief Qoraḥ, Chief Gatam, Chief Amalĕq. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Eḏom. They were the sons of Aḏah. [17] And these were the sons of Re‛u’ĕl, Ěsav’s son: Chief Naḥath, Chief Zeraḥ, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These were the chiefs of Re‛u’ĕl in the land of Eḏom. These were the sons of Basemath, Ěsav’s wife. [18] And these were the sons of Oholiḇamah, Ěsav’s wife: Chief Ye‛ush, Chief Ya‛lam, and Chief Qoraḥ. These were the chiefs descending from Oholiḇamah, Ěsav’s wife, the daughter of Anah. [19] These were the sons of Ěsav, who is Eḏom, and these were their chiefs.

readings.title: The Catalog of Esau’s Descendants
readings.subtitle: The Edomite Lineage Outlined
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 1:35] The sons of Ěsav: Eliphaz, Re‛u’ĕl, and Ye‛ush, and Ya‛lam, and Qoraḥ. [36] And the sons of Eliphaz: Tĕman, and Omar, Tsephi, and Gatam, and Qenaz, and Timna, and Amalĕq. [37] The sons of Re‛u’ĕl: Naḥath, Zeraḥ, Shammah, and Mizzah.

readings.title: The Native Administration of Seir
readings.subtitle: Cataloging the Horite Rulers
readings.text: [Genesis 36:20] These were the sons of Sĕ‛ir the Ḥorite who inhabited the land: Lotan, and Shoḇal, and Tsiḇ‛on, and Anah, [21] and Dishon, and Ětser, and Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Ḥorites, the sons of Sĕ‛ir, in the land of Eḏom. [22] And the sons of Lotan were Ḥori and Hĕmam. Lotan’s sister was Timna. [23] And these were the sons of Shoḇal: Alvan, and Manaḥath, and Ěyḇal, Shepho, and Onam. [24] And these were the sons of Tsiḇ‛on: both Ayah and Anah. This was the Anah who found <dn>את</dn> the water in the wilderness as he fed <dn>את</dn> the donkeys of his father Tsiḇ‛on. [25] And these were the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholiḇamah the daughter of Anah. [26] And these were the sons of Dishon: Ḥemdan, and Eshban, and Yithran, and Keran. [27] These were the sons of Ětser: Bilhan, and Za‛avan, and Aqan. [28] These were the sons of Dishan: Uts and Aran. [29] These were the chiefs of the Ḥorites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shoḇal, Chief Tsiḇ‛on, Chief Anah, [30] Chief Dishon, Chief Ětser, and Chief Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Ḥorites, according to their chiefs in the land of Sĕ‛ir.

readings.title: The Genealogy of the Horites
readings.subtitle: The Lineage of the Indigenous Rulers
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 1:38] And the sons of Sĕ‛ir: Lotan, and Shoḇal, and Tsiḇ‛on, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ětser, and Dishan. [39] And the sons of Lotan: Ḥori and Homam; Lotan’s sister was Timna. [40] The sons of Shoḇal: Alyan, and Manaḥath, and Ěyḇal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Tsiḇ‛on: Ayah and Anah. [41] The son of Anah was Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Ḥamran, and Eshban, and Yithran, and Keran. [42] The sons of Ětser: Bilhan, and Za‛avan, and Ya‛aqan. The sons of Dishan: Uts and Aran.

readings.title: The Rise of the Edomite Sovereigns
readings.subtitle: Structural Rulers Before the Israelite Monarchy
readings.text: [Genesis 36:31] And these were the sovereigns who reigned in the land of Eḏom before any sovereign reigned over the children of Yisra’ĕl. [32] And Bela the son of Be‛or reigned in Eḏom, and the name of his city was Dinhaḇah. [33] And Bela died, and Yoḇaḇ son of Zeraḥ of Botsrah reigned in his place. [34] And Yoḇaḇ died, and Ḥusham of the land of the Tĕmanites reigned in his place. [35] And Ḥusham died, and Haḏaḏ son of Beḏaḏ, who struck <dn>את</dn> Miḏyan in the field of Mo’aḇ, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith. [36] And Haḏaḏ died, and Samlah of Masrĕqah reigned in his place. [37] And Samlah died, and Sha’ul of Reḥoḇoth by the River reigned in his place. [38] And Sha’ul died, and Ba‛al-Ḥanan son of Aḵbor reigned in his place. [39] And Ba‛al-Ḥanan son of Aḵbor died, and Haḏar reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Pa‛u. And his wife’s name was Mehĕtaḇ’ĕl, the daughter of Matrĕḏ, the daughter of Mĕyzahaḇ. [40] And these were the names of the chiefs of Ěsav, according to their clans and their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Yethĕth, [41] Chief Oholiḇamah, Chief Ělah, Chief Pinon, [42] Chief Qenaz, Chief Tĕman, Chief Miḇtsar, [43] Chief Maḡdi’ĕl, Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Eḏom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. Ěsav was the father of the Eḏomites.

readings.title: The Succession of Edomite Power
readings.subtitle: Recording the Kings and Chiefs of Esau
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 1:43] And these were the sovereigns who reigned in the land of Eḏom before any sovereign reigned over the children of Yisra’ĕl: Bela son of Be‛or, and the name of his city was Dinhaḇah. [44] And when Bela died, Yoḇaḇ son of Zeraḥ of Botsrah reigned in his place. [45] And Yoḇaḇ died, and Ḥusham of the land of the Tĕmanites reigned in his place. [46] And when Ḥusham died, Haḏaḏ son of Beḏaḏ, who struck <dn>את</dn> Miḏyan in the field of Mo’aḇ, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith. [47] And Haḏaḏ died, and Samlah of Masrĕqah reigned in his place. [48] And Samlah died, and Sha’ul of Reḥoḇoth-by-the-River reigned in his place. [49] And Sha’ul died, and Ba‛al-Ḥanan son of Aḵbor reigned in his place. [50] And Ba‛al-Ḥanan died, and Haḏaḏ reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Pai. And his wife’s name was Mehĕtaḇ’ĕl the daughter of Matrĕḏ, the daughter of Mĕyzahaḇ. [51] And Haḏaḏ died. And the chiefs of Eḏom were Chief Timnah, Chief Alyah, Chief Yethĕth, [52] Chief Oholiḇamah, Chief Ělah, Chief Pinon, [53] Chief Qenaz, Chief Tĕman, Chief Miḇtsar, [54] Chief Maḡdi’ĕl, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Eḏom.

readings.title: The Sons of Yisra'el
readings.subtitle: The Foundation of the Earthly Assembly
readings.text: [1 Chronicles 2:1] These were the sons of Yisra’ĕl: Re’uḇĕn, Shim‛on, Lĕvi and Yehuḏah, Yissasḵar and Zeḇulun, [2] Dan, Yosĕph and Binyamin, Naphtali, Gaḏ and Ashĕr.
